about: THE shared formats (docs/48 'Shared formats'): everything two Sukrara apps exchange, its current version, its spec, the apps that speak it (ids of docs/48's app table, contracts/apps/apps.json) and what never moves in it ('frozen'). Until 1.0.0 every app reads only the current version ('reads': 'current'; the avatar is the one exception, 'every': an app keeps every renderer it shipped and draws the fallback for a newer one). A change an older app would misread raises 'version', lands in every app of 'apps' and releases them all (tools/formats/release_check.py, a release check); 'first' = the apps whose release goes out first, alone (the Connect IQ apps: their store approves in up to 3 days), the others in a later release once they are out; a change that must move a frozen part is a new format beside the old one, not a version. An app that meets another version names the app to update (the smaller version: docs/48 'When versions differ'). Bound by each app's tests: Android FormatsTest (:core:protocol, the sharing formats) and GarminAppsTest (:integrations, the watch payload), Mac FormatsTests (ShareTests), the Garmin apps' apps/garmin/tools/link_cases.py --check.

formats.name: Sharing: relays and Bluetooth
formats.carries: live readings, hour chunks, settings, roster, owner backup, alerts, the 30500 / 30501 rumors (request, profile, rekey, history, leave, version, key, revoked, invite-used, declined, pair), Bluetooth's HELLO / INFO and backlog

formats.name: Treatments
formats.carries: the treatment events (kind 30078, PROTOCOL-v2 'Treatments') of the wearer's log and of each writer

formats.name: Invite
formats.carries: the invite link and the invite rumor (kind 30502) it unlocks: expiry, relays, the wearer's profile

formats.name: Avatar
formats.carries: the numbers that draw a person's picture, inside every profile

formats.name: Watch payload and the watch's writes
formats.carries: the payload every profile gets (push and fetch), the fetch's report, the entries, undo and mute writes and their answers
